findings.title: Important Security Notice Nov 3, 2026: mSecure Support
findings.summary_md: mSeven Software's support forum opened an Important Security Notice Nov 3, 2026 discussion on November 3, 2026 at 12:36 AM Pacific time, reproducing the vendor notice sent to current and former mSecure customers. The notice urges recipients to change all stored passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys after suspicious activity tied to the application. Customer replies in the thread describe the email as vague and say it contains no technical details or scope of impact.

findings.title: Password manager mSecure tells users to change passwords, won't say why
findings.summary_md: The Register reported on November 3, 2026 that mSecure warned customers to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys without explaining the cause of the suspicious activity. The article quotes customers asking what data was affected, including one user who said they stored more than 500 passwords in the application and questioned whether the reset applied to every two-factor method and passkey.
